known_gaps: RE-BASELINED 2026-08-14 (see harness README 'RCT v03 date-boundary finding'): this deal's original 2026-06-09 screen predates the 2026-07-14 RCT v03 replacement-cost recalibration (a deliberate, ratified doctrine change -- old RCT v02 + 30%/25% floor ramp vs today's RCT v03 + 65%/60% ramp). REBASELINED 2026-08-15 (n=1 -> n=4, first-ever repeatability check for this deal, Gabriel-directed): the 2026-08-14 golden was a single unreplicated run whose Combined (0.0) was explicitly documented as a LOWER BOUND, not a point estimate (45 of 55 Quality points were null -- Product & Physical, Market & Location, Value-Add all unresolved that run). The 2026-08-15 forced-repeatability run added 3 independent replays (20.0/15.5/14.0) that each resolved Market & Location and Value-Add from the same frozen facts, which the original run did not. Golden Combined moved 0.0 -> 12.38 (mean of 4). This deal's own range across the 4 runs is 20.0 pts (stdev 8.63) -- BY FAR the widest in the golden set, and dramatically exceeds the harness's 5.0-pt tolerance. This is NOT ordinary replay-to-replay judgment noise the way Port Sheldon's or 1333 Research's dispersion is: it is largely an artifact of run 1 being a genuinely incomplete lower-bound construction, not a comparable full replay -- 3 of run 1's 5 non-floor categories were null where the other 3 runs resolved 2 of them. Flagged explicitly rather than averaged over silently; this deal is informational_only regardless so it does not gate, but a future reader should not treat this golden's dispersion as representative of normal replay variance.

The replays have 1-3 of 7 scorecard categories unresolvable from the frozen input packet per run (Product & Physical is null in 3 of 4 runs; Market & Location and Value-Add resolved in 3 of 4) -- the frozen input packet sourced from Notion's structured fields does not capture the physical/site detail the original live-tooled screen evidently had access to. Confidence kept LOW for this reason -- excluded from strict pass/fail.
NOI is not recorded anywhere (not disclosed, not derivable from a cap rate). Score components note '@ $700K' -- scoring used a $700,000 walk price, not the $950,000 asking price.
Notion's current 'Verdict' field reads KILLED (Gabriel's 2026-07-08 kill decision, post-hoc status overwrite) -- not a skill verdict-band output, see archived_pre_v03_reference.
